NONE: › used as a way of saying that you are not responsible for what someone else does or for what happens to them
各負其責；我無須為…負責
› something that you say in order to show your surprise or anger at something someone has done
這到底是甚麼回事？（對別人所做的事表示驚訝或憤怒）

example: They stayed for a month and left without even saying thank you! Well, I ask you!
他們住了一個月，卻連句謝謝都沒說就走了。這到底是甚麼回事？
